module: Powertrain component `manualGearbox`: manual gearbox with fixed ratios. The active gear is chosen by setGearIndex (integer indices: 0 neutral, positive = forward gears, negative = reverse). It simulates synchronizers (wear, gear grinding with "grinding" torque), neutral (virtual mass), friction, locking (setLock) and the gear whine/grinding sounds. Its parent must be a clutch (category `clutch`). A modder or a controller (e.g. manual gearbox controller) calls setGearIndex; the game reads gearIndex, gearRatio, outputAV1.
usage:
local gb = powertrain.getDevice("gearbox")
gb:setGearIndex(2)            -- 2nd, without synchro simulation
gb:setGearIndex(3, 0.15)      -- 3rd with 0.15 s of synchro time available
print(gb.gearIndex, gb.gearRatio, gb.isGrindingShift)
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, gearRatio, friction (N·m), dynamicFriction (N·m per rad/s), torqueLossCoef (0..1), neutralFriction (= friction), neutralDynamicFriction (= dynamicFriction), gearRatios (list, required: values >= 0 = forward gears starting at index 0 (neutral, value normally 0), values < 0 = reverse gears), gearDamageThreshold (3000, unused), gearWhineCoefs / gearWhineCoefsOutput / gearWhineCoefsInput, synchronizerSettings (table with header gearIndex, maxClutchRPMDifference (default 50), requiredClutchInput (0.8), maxSynchroRPMDifference (infinite), maxSynchroRate (5000), synchroWearCoef (0.000005)), gearboxNode_nodes (first node = transmissionNodeID), breakTriggerBeam, and for the sounds: gearGrindSoundFile, gearGrindEvent, gearWhineOutputEvent, gearWhineInputEvent, forwardInputPitchCoef, forwardOutputPitchCoef, reverseInputPitchCoef (0.7), reverseOutputPitchCoef (0.7), gearWhine*PitchCoefSmoothing (50), gearWhine*VolumeCoefSmoothing (10), gearWhineFixedCoefOutput (0.7), gearWhineFixedCoefInput (0.4).

Gear indexing: the jbeam list gearRatios separates the values >= 0 (forward, indices 0, 1, 2…) and < 0 (reverse). For n reverse gears, the first negative value in the list takes the index -n, the last one the index -1. gearRatios[0] is neutral (ratio 0 expected).

Main fields: gearIndex, gearRatio (current ratio, signed, 0 = neutral), gearRatios (table keyed by gearIndex), minGearIndex, maxGearIndex, maxGearRatio, minGearRatio, gearCount, inputAV (rad/s, clutch side), outputAV1 (rad/s, output shaft side, set by the child), outputTorque1 (N·m), inputTorque, lockCoef (0 if locked by setLock), isBroken, isGrindingShift, grindingShiftTargetIndex, grindingTorque, synchroWear (table per gear, 0..1), virtualMassAV, cumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio, maxCumulativeGearRatio, transmissionNodeID.

Neutral or broken gearbox (gearRatio == 0 or isBroken): velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate switch to the "neutral" versions where the input accelerates a virtual mass (virtualMassAV) and outputTorque1 only contains the grinding reaction.

setGearIndex(index) without availableSyncTime: the shift always succeeds (compatibility). With availableSyncTime: the shift fails (grinding) if the speed difference exceeds the synchro capacity, if the clutch is not depressed enough (requiredClutchInput) or if the available synchro time is too short. A grind activates setGearGrinding and applies a torque (max 50 N·m) until the speed gap drops below 20 rad/s.
The synchro wear of a gear reaches 1: the ratio is set to 0 (the gear becomes unusable until reset).
Minor bug: reset calls device:setGearIndex(0), which requires a valid parent; reset sets isShiftGrinding = false but the field actually used is isGrindingShift.
Minor bug: calculateInertia computes invCumulativeInertia = 1 / cumulativeInertia without protection against a zero inertia (division by zero gives inf if there is no child).

new.desc: Builds the gearbox: reads gearRatios and builds the forward/reverse index tables, the gear whine coefficients, the synchronizer settings and the transmission node, then goes to neutral via setGearIndex(0).

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (gearRatios required).

updateSounds.desc: Updates the volume and pitch of the gear whine sound loops (input and output) from the smoothed speeds/torques and the current gear. Called every frame by the powertrain.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: inputAV = outputAV1 * gearRatio * lockCoef (or virtual mass in neutral) and written to the parent.

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step: outputTorque1 = (parent torque - friction) * gearRatio * lockCoef, and feeds the sound smoothers. In neutral, calls updateGrinding, integrates the virtual mass and returns the grinding reaction.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds (used in neutral).

updateGrinding.desc: During a grinding shift: computes the grinding torque and its sign, wears the synchro of the targeted gear, engages the gear when the speed gap falls below 20 rad/s, plays the grinding sound and displays "Synchronizer damage" messages.

setGearGrinding.desc: Enables or stops the grinding state: stores the targeted gear and the max torque, starts or stops the grinding sound loop.

active.desc: true to start the grinding, false to stop it and reset everything.

targetGearIndex.desc: Index of the targeted gear (if active).

maxGrindingTorque.desc: Maximum grinding torque in N·m (if active).

updateGFX.desc: Per-frame update: currently empty (the debug and gear skip code is commented out).

setGearIndex.desc: Engages a gear. The index is clamped to [minGearIndex, maxGearIndex]. Without availableSyncTime, the shift always succeeds; with it, simulates the synchros and can trigger a grind (shift refused: the gear stays the old one). Recomputes the powertrain inertia if the gear is non-zero. 0 = neutral.

index.desc: Index of the desired gear (0 neutral, >0 forward, <0 reverse).

availableSyncTime.desc: Duration in seconds during which the synchro could work; nil = do not simulate the synchros.

onBreak.desc: Marks the gearbox as broken and switches to neutral mode (virtualMassAV). Called when the breakTriggerBeam beam breaks or via setPartCondition.

setLock.desc: Locks or unlocks the transmission: lockCoef = 0 (locked, no torque or speed transmitted) or 1. Propagates the call to the parent (clutch) if it has setLock.

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases the damage friction coefficient (0.01 of damage = +0.1).

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies wear (odometer), damage (integrity number 0..1 or table) and synchro wear. Calls onBreak if the table indicates isBroken.

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the integrity 0..1 (0 if broken) and the table {damageFrictionCoef, synchroWear, isBroken}.

validate.desc: Checks that the parent is a clutch (or a fake one), logs an error and returns false otherwise. Determines transmissionNodeID and the expected values (max engine torque and speed, power) used to normalize the sounds.

returns.desc: false if the parent is not a clutch.

calculateInertia.desc: Takes the inertia and cumulative ratios of the first child; cumulativeInertia = downstream inertia / gearRatio² (with 2 * maxGearRatio in neutral).

resetSounds.desc: Resets the sound smoothers and values (gear whine).

initSounds.desc: Creates the sound objects (grinding, input and output gear whine), the smoothers and the pitch/volume coefficients from the jbeam, and sets the FMOD parameter c_gearboxMaxPower.

reset.desc: Resets the state (speeds, torque, wear, original ratios, synchros, damage) then goes back to neutral.
